name: FNCE 3101
title: Financial Management
description: (Also offered as BADM 3730.) An introductory examination of how a business plans its needs for funds, raises the necessary funds, and invests them to attain its goals.
requirement_description: ACCT 2001; ECON 1200 or both ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) and ECON 1202; MATH 1070Q and MATH 1071Q, or MATH 1131Q and MATH 1070Q or MATH 1132Q, or MATH 1125Q, MATH 1126Q and MATH 1132Q or MATH 1070Q; STAT 1000Q or 1100Q; open to Business majors with 40 or more credits. May not be taken out of sequence after passing FNCE 3302, 3303, 4209, 4302, FNCE 4304, 4305, 4306, 4307, 4308, 4309, 4410, 4420, 4430, 4450.
